# bizkit_project (Resource)

A project in the workspace. Forms, lists, endpoints and analytics belong to a project. Destroying a project deletes everything in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bizkit_project" "website" {
  slug = "website"
  name = "Website"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name.
- `slug` (String) The URL-safe name, unique in the workspace. Changing it replaces the project.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The project ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by ID.
tofu import bizkit_project.example <id>
```
